definitions.gloss: rest; recuperation; convalescence; taking a break to recover
definitions.explanation: Resting quietly in order to recover from illness, injury, fatigue, or stress. Implies a period of reduced activity for health recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧{静養|せいよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{静養|せいよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me to rest and recuperate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{温泉|おんせん}{地|ち}→温泉地：28309_onsenchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧ほど{静養|せいよう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}した→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧。
examples.english: After the surgery, I recuperated at a hot spring resort for about a week before returning to work.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb ({静養|せいよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). A somewhat formal word that often appears in news about public figures taking medical leave or in medical advice. Implies a deliberate period of quiet rest, not just ordinary relaxation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静養|せいよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rest, to recuperate)
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{静養|せいよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to recuperate at home)
- {静養|せいよう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (currently recuperating)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休養|きゅうよう}→休養：11450_kyuuyou⟧: rest, relaxation — broader term, includes resting for any reason
- ⟦{療養|りょうよう}→療養：08207_ryouyou⟧: medical treatment and rest — specifically for recovery from illness under medical care
